title: Real Asset Acquisition Corp. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-07
summary: Real Asset Acquisition Corp., a Cayman Islands SPAC, and IQM Finland Oy jointly announced on April 7, 2026, that IQM submitted a confidential draft registration statement on Form F-4 to the SEC in connection with their previously announced business combination, which will result in IQM becoming a publicly traded company on Nasdaq.
key_points: Real Asset Acquisition Corp. (ticker RAAQ) is a Cayman Islands SPAC listed on Nasdaq (units: RAAQU, shares: RAAQ, warrants: RAAQW)
On February 22, 2026, RAAQ and IQM entered into a business combination agreement for IQM to become publicly traded
IQM is a Finnish limited liability company (IQM Finland Oy) with a US subsidiary (IQM US LLC)
On April 7, 2026, IQM confidentially submitted a draft registration statement on Form F-4 to the SEC
The registration statement includes a preliminary proxy statement of RAAQ and preliminary prospectus of IQM
RAAQ shareholders will vote on the transaction at an Extraordinary General Meeting after the registration statement is declared effective
